dz: 什维特里加伊拉和西吉斯蒙德克斯图塔伊蒂斯部队之间的第一次战斗是在奥斯米亚纳(英语:Oszmiana (Ashmyany))镇附近进行的,发动了立陶宛内战最活跃的阶段.
de: The first battle between the forces of Švitrigaila and Sigismund Kęstutaitis is fought near the town of Oszmiana (Ashmyany), launching the most active phase of the Lithuanian Civil War.
